why: The resuming process drops its declared balance line entirely and keeps every status. Nothing else about the run changes: the resumed history is intact, the A5 fold bracket is intact, expect.live is intact. This is the mutant that survived while Mode::Truncated was handed to EVERY sequence of an interrupted execution -- an empty slice is a contiguous slice of anything, so a vanished balance read as 'cut short'. Interruption is a pagination event and only history.read is paginated; balances are batched and owed in full by every execution, interrupted or not.
